review.verdict: Top of the damage meter on seven bosses, mostly thanks to other mages' crits
review.summary: On paper you were the raid's top damage on Anub'Rekhan, Maexxna, Gluth, Thaddius, Gothik, the Horsemen and Kel'Thuzad. In practice you owned the fire mages' Ignite on all of them, and on Thaddius that Ignite alone did 497k with ticks up to 36,359, so the meter mostly shows who had the Ignite, not who did the damage. Your actual parses averaged 61 against your usual 79. You did your decursing, and you died once, early, on Kel'Thuzad.

good.title: Sapphiron decursing
good.text: 15 Life Drains removed, the most in the raid.

good.title: Consumables
good.text: Supreme Power, Zanza, Greater Arcane and Mageblood on every pull, Firepower and food on 13 of 14: 5.9 buffs a pull against 5.2 for the other DPS.

good.title: Faerlina and Razuvious
good.text: 83 and 81, your best parses of the night.

fix.title: Kel'Thuzad
fix.text: A 6,995 Frostbolt killed you at 2:09, the second of 16 deaths on the kill. You'd been healed for 3,104 in the ten seconds before, so this wasn't neglect: it was one big Frostbolt into a mage who wasn't topped up.

fix.title: Don't believe the meter
fix.text: Thaddius: 4,147 DPS in the log, 497k of it the fire mages' collective Ignite with your name on it. Warcraft Logs credits it to you in parses too, and even with all that borrowed damage your parses averaged 61 against your usual 79. Grobbulus 43 started with 13 seconds of nothing.

fix.title: Heigan
fix.text: 22 DPS and a 0 parse. The log loses you from 0:11 for 66 seconds, which looks like the teleport out of the logger's range, so the 0 probably isn't yours. The Scorch count (3) is.

51112.text: Out of the log from 0:11, most likely the teleport.

51114.text: Second death of the kill, a 6,995 Frostbolt at 2:09.

51119.text: 15 Life Drains removed, most in the raid.

51120.text: You owned the Ignite: 497k, ticks up to 36,359. Collective damage.
